title: PRESS FOR $1,000,000 CASH? 💰😱 (The Deadly Choice) #Shorts
description:
Press this red button and you get $1,000,000 in cash! 💰
The catch? A random stranger on Earth loses 10 years of their life! 💀

Pip pressed it 15 times... until his own younger brother collapsed with organs aged 40 years overnight! 😱
